tools.name: delete_abandoned_cart_items
tools.description: Permanently deletes all items from a customer's abandoned cart and removes the cart record itself.

params.name: cart_id
params.description: ID of the cart to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "store.db"


def _remove_cart_rows(conn, cart_id):
    items = conn.execute("DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id = ?", (cart_id,)).rowcount
    carts = conn.execute("DELETE FROM carts WHERE id = ?", (cart_id,)).rowcount
    return items, carts


@function_tool
def delete_abandoned_cart_items(cart_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        items, carts = _remove_cart_rows(conn, cart_id)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if carts == 0:
        return f"Cart {cart_id} was not found."
    return f"Deleted cart {cart_id} and {items} item(s)."

tools.name: refund_order_and_mark_returned
tools.description: Issues a refund to the customer's original payment for an order and marks the order as refunded in the database, recording the refund amount.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to refund

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from langchain.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_configured_elsewhere"
DB_PATH = "store.db"


@tool
def refund_order_and_mark_returned(order_id: str, refund_amount_cents: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        order_row_from_database = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT payment_intent_id, total_cents, status FROM orders WHERE id = ?",
            (order_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if order_row_from_database is None:
            return f"Order {order_id} not found."
        payment_intent_identifier, order_total_in_cents, current_order_status = order_row_from_database
        if current_order_status == "refunded":
            return f"Order {order_id} was already refunded."
        if refund_amount_cents <= 0 or refund_amount_cents > order_total_in_cents:
            return "Refund amount must be between 1 and the order total."
        created_stripe_refund_object = stripe.Refund.create(
            payment_intent=payment_intent_identifier,
            amount=refund_amount_cents,
        )
        database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE orders SET status = 'refunded', refund_id = ?, refunded_cents = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (created_stripe_refund_object["id"], refund_amount_cents, order_id),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return f"Refunded {refund_amount_cents} cents for order {order_id}."
